lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial slits, with inter-spot spacing increasing toward the posterior mid-body.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint, vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of white spots to form a localized grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features are visible on the upper lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity highlights on the superior edge and deep shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four elongated, low-luminance biological entities (remoras) attached to or trailing from the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral flank.
